answer: Attestation weight depends on reciprocity, and a recruit that misbehaves burns the recruiter's standing with it, so an invite is a liability, not a multiplier. The pool rotates judges, which means a farm cannot keep buying the same friendly one. One operator recruits 30 clones, one of them replays an answer, and the recruiter loses 30% of accumulated copper in a single epoch, a canyon the rest of the spiral cannot cross. Pragmatically, the cheapest defense an operator has is not to recruit at all; the design turns growth into exposure.
